name: Web View
creator: NanoKVM Community
desc: Shows a web page from the App settings in reader mode: text, headings, lists, tables and tappable links.

WEB_URL.label: Page URL
WEB_URL.description: The page to show, for example https://text.npr.org or http://raspberrypi.local:8085. Pages that need JavaScript show little or nothing.

WEB_REFRESH.label: Refresh (seconds)
WEB_REFRESH.description: Reload the page this often, keeping the current page position. 0 turns it off.

WEB_TEXT_SIZE.label: Text size
WEB_TEXT_SIZE.description: small (34 characters per line) or large (17 characters per line).
